task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Remove BOX_MIDDLE from the box stack and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. Since only the top box can be picked, first remove BOX_TOP temporarily to TEMP_TABLE, then pick BOX_MIDDLE, place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, then retrieve BOX_TOP from TEMP_TABLE and place it back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack minus the middle box.
assumptions: BOX_TOP is on top of the stack and must be removed first before BOX_MIDDLE can be picked
TEMP_TABLE is a suitable temporary holding location for BOX_TOP
After BOX_TOP is placed back on BOX_BOTTOM, the stack will consist of BOX_BOTTOM supporting BOX_TOP, with BOX_MIDDLE removed
Navigation tolerance of 0.5 is sufficient to stay within the interaction distance of 2.0 for all pick and place operations
